_decision: FOOTER_MAX_HEIGHT = 122px (the approved 3-icon cap), re-derived from bidezine's own already-shipped values rather than borrowed from origin's literal: RAIL_BUTTON_SIZE (38, the real size-[38px]) x 3 + FOOTER_GAP (4, the real gap-1) x 2 = 122.
_history: This is the row that produced CLAUDE.md checklist item 26's fourth axis. It was recorded as APPROVED and RESOLVED while the cap was never wired into the code at all — the footer column had no max-height and no overflow rule of any kind. It was invisible because this rail ships only 2 footer items, comfortably under the 3-icon threshold that would ever clip. A documented decision is not evidence of an implemented one; this check is what makes the difference machine-checkable.
_note: Asserts overflow: hidden alongside the height, because the cap only clips with both. A max-height on its own merely stops the flex parent growing and would leave a 4th item visibly overflowing.
